command: Run exactly one bounded zero-cost parallel_offline observer dependency-contract integration. Preserve all unrelated and existing uncommitted work. Verify and bind the six content-addressed inputs, including the reconciled result. Treat the prior initial result-record mismatch as an operational failure only; do not update scientific beliefs. Using test-driven development, integrate the validated versioned event contract into the next-observer specification and deterministic preparation gates without creating a fresh paid identity or provider launcher. Require exact request_id and scheduler_iteration_id; explicit CPU and CUDA clock domains plus calibration mapping; cuda_stream_id; graph_launch_id and graph_node_id boundaries; kernel start/end intervals; and request/iteration-scoped dependency edges. Define attribution from the union of non-overlapping dependency-linked intervals only, never summed kernel duration or timestamp containment. Bind stable event IDs, monotonic per-domain timestamps, referential integrity, graph/stream linkage for every kernel interval, and fail-closed rejection of absent or cross-wired fields. Prove the unchanged stored-trace stock control remains rejected at 0.0 coverage, the integrated synthetic candidate reaches at least 0.95 coverage, two replays are byte-identical, and mutations for every required field class fail closed. Prove eligible partial-evidence packaging retains the exact raw request and event rows needed by the contract and its hashed manifest. Preserve STOCK_STARTUP exclusion, A1/B1/A2 ordering, observer-off/on/off perturbation gates, frozen quality/correctness and SLO policy hashes, exact raw request/event identities, cost, low-overhead host/GPU telemetry, logs, observer-bracketed deep profiling, existing maximum future paid-run spend and cleanup reserve, every historical deadline, partial-evidence recovery, and verified compute/disk cleanup. Maximum spend is $0.00; timeout is 480 seconds; seed is 47022501. Retain immutable input inventory, integration-manifest.json, schema-binding.json, valid integrated fixture, missing/cross-wire mutation results, partial-packaging result, focused test logs, result.md, result-record.json, hashes.txt, verification.log, and verification-exit.txt below the supervisor-provided worker output directory; store the evidence and call record --kind result. Run only narrow deterministic Python tests and python3 tools/devex/check.py. Do not inspect or mutate a provider, prepare or admit a paid identity, launch or poll a provider controller, change budget authority, alter any paid-run deadline, update scientific beliefs, commit, or push. If a gate fails, retain the operational result, prohibit promotion, and name the exact missing integration requirement without retrying unchanged work.
